hints.title: Greedy Maximum Value Extraction
hints.text: To maximize score at each step, always pick the largest remaining value available.

hints.title: Logarithmic Extraction Structure
hints.text: Insert all elements into a max-oriented container to pop the top element efficiently.

hints.title: Ceiling Division Update
hints.text: Add popped value to score, replace it with ceil(val / 3) calculated as (val + 2) // 3, and insert back.

hints.title: Maximal Score Priority Simulation Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import heapq

class Solution:
    def maxKelements(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        pq = [-x for x in nums]
        heapq.heapify(pq)
        score = 0
        for _ in range(k):
            x = -heapq.heappop(pq)
            score += x
            heapq.heappush(pq, -((x + 2) // 3))
        return score
```

complexity.notes: Linear time heapify followed by k logarithmic extract-max and insert steps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated linear scan to find maximum takes O(k * n).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) memory stores elements in max-heap.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Selects max-heap and handles ceil division (x + 2) // 3 cleanly.
